bind.description: Null operand returns null; otherwise use existing51ac10 first matching case-insensitive locator lookup. Null system returns null through that lookup. Initialized locator identity is retained separately from packet selection.

range.description: Require script creature and creature+d0 reference presence, without dereferencing its world pointer. Explicit initialized locator takes precedence over packet+a4 selected locator. Missing target returns FLT_MAX. Measure Euclidean distance from controller+14c to locator+10, not actor+5c or actor+80. Referenced actor may have a null world object.

distance.description: Non-null scratch branch stores three float32 differences; products and ordered sum use x87 intermediates before float32 square storage. Existing original square-root helper then returns float32 length. Finite input/result domain, no malformed pointers or null-scratch ABI claimed.

random.description: Direct tail thunk to already recovered5b9dd0: advance shared uintLCG95e5d4 by state*19660d+3c6ef35f, then convert low23bits dividedby8388608 to a float in[0,1). Every condition evaluation draws again; no cached operand or independent per-condition RNG.

native.method: Original initializer, locator lookup, range condition, distance/sqrt and Random tail thunk execute unchanged. Exact float32 return and shared RNG state, input-region write checks; no behavior substitutions.

limits: Finite coordinates and finite squared-distance result; original nonnull scratch length helper. Bound locator identity and controller position supplied.
Condition comparison/connective scheduling remains the existing separate scheduler contract. Authored rows retain their source but are not whole-script execution.
